lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, organized into approximately 7-8 discernible vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a geometric grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, showing a characteristic light-above-shadow-below gradient running parallel to the horizontal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of small, high-luminance circular blobs distributed across the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch and ragged texture on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin; several small dark-pigmented depressions or potential lesions visible on the lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, lower-luminance silhouette of a commensal organism (likely a remora) positioned beneath the ventral surface near the pectoral fin base.
